derivation: from H6556 (פֶּרֶץ) and H5798 (עֻזָּא); break of Uzza;

occurrences.text: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez–uzzah to this day.
And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day.
